name: Konno Tamami
source:
A very gentle-hearted girl with an easygoing, calm atmosphere. She works hard as the manager of the boys' Basketball Club. Although she looks childish, she considers herself to be a reliable, sensible person. Her younger brother is apparently a classmate of Tsukushi's.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.tokimemo-type.com/tkmkgstype/character/index.html]official website[/url]]
